introduction: The `afaudit` package extracts all audit file-writing infrastructure from the `agentfox` core into a standalone, stdlib-only Python package, enabling lightweight consumers to depend on audit primitives without transitive heavy dependencies. It provides the event model, sink protocol, agent trace sink, postmortem writer, cleanup utilities, and supporting constants for producing the three audit file types (`audit_*.jsonl`, `agent_*.jsonl`, `postmortem_*.json`).

execution_paths.title: Produce all three audit file types using only afaudit

steps.action: imports `AuditJsonlSink`, `AgentTraceSink`, `build_postmortem`, `write_postmortem`, and `AUDIT_DIR` from `afaudit` with no agentfox import
instantiates `AuditJsonlSink` pointed at `AUDIT_DIR` and writes `AuditEvent` objects, producing an `audit_*.jsonl` file
instantiates `AgentTraceSink` and records agent turn data, producing an `agent_*.jsonl` file
calls `build_postmortem()` with an object satisfying `PostmortemInput`, then calls `write_postmortem()` to persist the result, producing a `postmortem_*.json` file
contains all three audit file types in `audit_dir` with no agentfox module having been imported
calls `enforce_file_retention(audit_dir=AUDIT_DIR, max_runs=20)` from `afaudit.cleanup`
globs `audit_dir` for `audit_*.jsonl` files, parses the `YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_hex` timestamp from each filename, and sorts runs chronologically
identifies runs beyond `max_runs` (the oldest ones) and deletes all three corresponding files (`audit_*.jsonl`, `agent_*.jsonl`, `postmortem_*.json`) for each such run
returns the total count of successfully deleted files to the caller

execution_paths.title: Enforce file retention — missing audit directory

steps.action: calls `enforce_file_retention(audit_dir=Path('/nonexistent'), max_runs=20)`
detects that `audit_dir` does not exist on the filesystem
returns 0 silently without logging or raising any exception

execution_paths.title: Atomic workspace migration — single PR sequence

steps.action: creates `packages/afaudit/` with all modules, tests, and `pyproject.toml` on a feature branch
deletes the source modules from `agentfox` (no shims left behind)
adds `afaudit>=4.0.2` to `agentfox/pyproject.toml` [project.dependencies] so the workspace resolver can locate the new package
updates all ~60 production import sites in `agentfox`, `af`, and `nightshift` to use `afaudit.*` equivalents
updates all ~30 test import sites, physically relocating test files that exclusively exercise `afaudit` symbols into `packages/afaudit/tests/`
removes `AUDIT_DIR` from `agentfox.core.node_id` and moves the DB-retention logic to `agentfox.knowledge.duckdb_sink`
runs `make check`; all lint and tests pass; implementer documents test isolation verification in the PR description

error_handling.condition: `audit_dir` does not exist when `enforce_file_retention()` is called
error_handling.behavior: Return 0 silently without raising any exception or emitting any log message

error_handling.condition: An `audit_*.jsonl` filename does not match the expected `YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_hex` timestamp pattern during `enforce_file_retention()` execution
error_handling.behavior: Log a WARNING via the `afaudit.cleanup` logger identifying the unparseable filename, skip the file entirely (do not delete it), and continue processing remaining files

error_handling.condition: A file deletion operation fails during `enforce_file_retention()` (e.g. due to a permissions error or race condition)
error_handling.behavior: Log the error at WARNING level via the `afaudit.cleanup` logger, continue attempting deletion of remaining files, and exclude the failed file from the return value count

error_handling.condition: A third-party dependency is added to `afaudit/pyproject.toml` [project.dependencies]
error_handling.behavior: The dependency isolation check fails; the implementer must remove the dependency and document the verification in the PR description before the PR can be merged

error_handling.condition: `SinkDispatcher._dispatch_optional` is referenced in an external call-site or test file
error_handling.behavior: Treat as a private API violation; the reference must be removed. The method's single-underscore prefix signals it is an implementation detail of `SinkDispatcher` and not part of the guaranteed public API

error_handling.condition: `make check` fails after the atomic migration is applied
error_handling.behavior: The feature branch is amended or rebased locally until all lint and tests pass; no partial merge is permitted since the branch is local-only
